description: VRM expressions as mixes of Anny's ARKit facial actions. presets: the VRM 1.0 presets (vrm0Preset names the VRM 0.x preset; null makes a 0.x custom group named vrm0Name). perfectSync: one custom per facial action, named in PascalCase. customs: further customs (versions limits them to some VRM versions). CONTRACT (PR 1): placeholder values; stream A3 sets the mixes, the override flags and the VSeeFace visemes.
